credentials.title: Teyes account
credentials.description: Sign in with the account you use on the Teyes portal.

token.title: Session token
token.description: Open the Teyes portal in a signed-in browser and read localStorage on online.teyes.cn: ucenterToken and uid. Your cars are found automatically.

select.title: Cars
select.description: Tick the cars to add to Home Assistant. You can change this later in the integration's options.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Teyes cloud.
error.unknown_device: No cars were found for this account.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data.enable_push: Listen for live reports from the car
data.coordinate_system: Coordinate system the car reports in

data_description.device_ids: Tick the cars this account should follow.
data_description.enable_push: Keeps a socket open to the Teyes cloud so position and speed arrive as the car sends them.
data_description.coordinate_system: Leave on WGS-84 unless the car's position shows up a few hundred metres off inside China.

api_call.name: Call the Teyes API
api_call.description: Send a request to any Teyes endpoint and return the decoded reply. Useful for trying endpoints this integration does not cover yet.

entry_id.name: Account
entry_id.description: Which configured account to use. Defaults to the only one.

device_id.name: Car
device_id.description: Device id (imei) of the car to act on. Defaults to the account's first car.

api.name: API
api.description: client is the account API (clientv3). The rest are the car API hosts this account was given: car, track, acc, msg, file, update, ef, tmps.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Extra parameters. uid, imei, token, language and timezone are added automatically.

send_command.name: Send a command to the car
send_command.description: Publish a command to the head unit over its live connection. The car must be online. Known commands: lockscreen, unlockscreen, app_location, close4g; more can be captured from the app (see tools/).

entry_id.name: Account

device_id.name: Car
device_id.description: Device id (imei) of the car. Defaults to the account's first car.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command type, for example lockscreen.

message.name: Message
message.description: The command's payload, if it needs one. Defaults to empty.
